summary: Alien game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Alien: Isolation

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC Collection with all DLC

primary.version: Alien: Isolation Collection / all DLC installed
primary.why: The PC Collection route gives high-fidelity capture and includes the game's DLC packs. Later Switch/mobile ports are impressive access routes, but PC remains the cleanest archive route for resolution/settings and complete DLC capture.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC Collection through Steam or GOG with all DLC installed. Record storefront/build, graphics settings, DLC packs, difficulty, save state, and whether console/Switch/mobile ports were compared.

secondary.why: It is a notable later port, but not the highest-control archive capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC ownership, storefront, and graphics/AA settings; later ports are separate comparison routes.
